items.title: 'HOPE' making of trailer includes Alicia Vikander and Michael Fassbender mocap sessions
items.excerpt: A making-of trailer for 'HOPE' shows Alicia Vikander and Michael Fassbender's performance-capture sessions and how the mocap data drove the film's fully digital characters.

items.title: Nura Studios Opens Showcraft AI Production Platform to the Public
items.excerpt: Showcraft takes a story from script, shot list or concept through storyboard, animatic, animation and final edit in one connected environment; the tools behind 'Rainbow Hollow' and 'Astro Burn' are now open to everyone.

items.title: Avid Media Composer 2026.8 is now available
items.excerpt: Media Composer 2026.8 ships with deeper Avid Content Core integration and expanded agentic workflow intelligence, including automated content prep for editors, alongside big third-party storage changes.

items.title: Utopai Studios, DeNA Team on AI-Assisted Animation Projects in Japan
items.excerpt: Utopai Studios and DeNA will co-develop AI-assisted animation production in Japan, with the partners insisting artists retain final creative control over the pipeline.

items.title: Inside Camelback Productions' Plans for a New 1,400-Acre, AI-Powered Production Complex
items.excerpt: Anita Verma-Lallian's 1,400-acre Arizona complex is being designed around AI-native production stages and virtual production volumes rather than retrofitting a traditional backlot.

items.title: Nicola Coughlan Attacks AI Voice Cloning, But Is Government Listening?
items.excerpt: The Nicola Coughlan-backed Save Our Voices Now campaign is pressing the UK government over AI voice cloning, a fight that directly shapes how performance and likeness can be synthesised in film and TV.

items.title: George Clooney Says AI Will 'Hurt Us' and Questions Paramount and Warner Bros. Merger
items.excerpt: Clooney used his Venice press conference to argue that generative AI will damage film crafts and creative labour, tying it to consolidation anxieties around the Paramount-WBD merger.

items.title: ArtStation Enables NoAI Protection for Every Artist by Default
items.excerpt: ArtStation has switched NoAI protection on for new and existing uploads and added crawler blocking, a direct response to concept artists and film-design portfolios being scraped for training data.

items.title: Introducing GWM Worlds 2, a Playable World Model
items.excerpt: Runway's GWM Worlds 2 generates explorable, playable environments in real time — a shift from clip generation toward navigable worlds that previs and virtual production could stage inside.

items.title: We Found a Weird Seedance Character Hack
items.excerpt: Curious Refuge breaks down a face-grid technique for holding character consistency across Seedance-generated shots — a practical continuity workaround for AI-assisted narrative work.

items.title: Avid Media Composer 2026.8 at IBC: Agentic Workflows, More
items.excerpt: Avid brings 'Ready to Edit' and expanded agentic workflow intelligence to IBC, automating content prep so editors start from an organised, AI-assembled bin rather than raw rushes.
